## Usage

### Accessing Backups
All backups maintain the original directory structure for easy reference.

```bash
# View a backed-up configuration
cat docs/templates/claude-md-backups/services/services/auth-service/CLAUDE.md

# List all app configurations
ls -la docs/templates/claude-md-backups/apps/
```

### Restoration
To restore a backed-up CLAUDE.md to its original location:

```bash
# Example: restore auth-service configuration
cp docs/templates/claude-md-backups/services/services/auth-service/CLAUDE.md services/auth-service/CLAUDE.md
```
